Learned advocate representing the petitioner being aggrieved by the order dated 24th April, 2025 passed by the 2nd Court of Additional District & Sessions Judge, Bongaon, District North 24 Parganas "rejecting the application for transfer of this case to any other Court for trial filed by the accused before this Court being Trial Court itself, the accused were given opportunity to move before the Appropriate Forum if there are reasonable apprehension that a fair and impartial trial cannot be had in this Court" vide order dated 02.05.2025.

entities.text: 2nd Court of Additional District & Sessions Judge, Bongaon, District North 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. The aforesaid Court inter alia observed as follows:
"Since the accused have filed an application before the Hon'ble Court for transfer of this case from this Court vide CRR No.-1968 of 2025, an opportunity should be given to the accused to bring appropriate order from the Hon'ble Court.
The accused persons are directed to bring the appropriate order from the Hon'ble Court by the next date in default the case shall be proceeded further as per law.

To 02/06/2025 for appearance of the accused on Court bail, production of the accused in judicial custody, filing appropriate order of the Hon'ble Court by the accused in default filing of money receipt showing payment of cost of Rs.10,000/- by 86 vs In Re: Sri Anirban Bala on 30 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189594222/
1
the accused in the fund of SDLSC, Bongaon and then further cross- examination of the P.W.-19 in default cross-examination shall be deemed to be closed.

Let a copy of this order be sent to the Chairman, SDLSC, Bongaon for information."
3. Let the matter be placed before the Regular Bench on 10 th June, 2025.
4.
Learned advocate representing the petitioner is to serve notice upon the learned advocate representing the State intimating the next date of hearing.
5. The order dated 2nd May, 2025 be stayed till 10th June, 2025.
6. A copy of this order be communicated to the Trial Court in the meantime.

(Ananya Bandyopadhyay, J.)
